title: Cytokinetics (CYTK) Reaches A Phase 3 First In Non Obstructive HCM
summary: Cytokinetics (NasdaqGS: CYTK) reports positive Phase 3 results for aficamten (MYQORZO) in patients with symptomatic non-obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. The trial is described as the first successful clinical study in this indication, with results presented at a major cardiology conference and published in leading medical journals. title: Jefferies starts biopharma firm Braveheart at Buy after IPO
summary: Investing.com -- Jefferies initiated coverage of Braveheart Bio with a Buy rating and a $48 price target, implying roughly 75% upside from the stock’s prior closing price. The move comes after the company priced its initial public offering (IPO) at $18 per share earlier this month, raising $382.5 million in one of the largest biotech debuts of 2026.
